test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan is related with:

options.text: Developing India by identifying and creating 'Smart Cities'
Developing rural India with the help of higher education institutions
Improving the living conditions by improving cleanliness and public sanitation
Making India a super power through investments in science and technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Developing rural India with the help of higher education institutions.**__

 
• **Unnat Bharat Abhiyan** is a flagship program of the Ministry of Education.
 
• It is aimed at** developing rural India with the help of higher education institutions.**
